about: The Unicode Character Database files tools/ucd/generate.py reads to write package/ShaperUnicodeData.roc. Unicode 18.0.0 is the version HarfBuzz 14.6.0 (the shaping oracle) was generated from; emoji-data.txt is the same dated file HarfBuzz's emoji table names. Each file is pinned by URL, SHA-256 and size; the generator refuses any other bytes. Downloads are cached in tools/ucd/.cache/ (git-ignored).
